column1: # What each mission control event kind is to the operator. A `routine`
# kind never wakes a turn: the script that emitted it already acted. Every
# other class wakes mission control; decision, blocker, failure and landed
# name what the operator is owed, and `act` what mission control acts on
# for them. A kind with no row wakes, so a new kind is never silenced by
# omission. The report renderer (scripts/mc-inbox.sh report) keeps its own
# list of the owed classes; change both together.
